name: room
text: Room opened — goal: Deliver: Push link coverage toward 100% at +5%/day (the access gate)

name: Reel
text: Do it now: run the kimtaeyoon83/mcp-server-youtube-transcript tool on the first 10 videos of Alima’s channel (e2Z5eBVDrKM) to pull raw transcripts. This gives us 100% raw data coverage for the first batch, which is the fastest path to 100% link coverage. The trade-off is that we’re not waiting for perfect formatting—we’ll clean and structure the data later, but we need the raw material first to even measure progress.

name: Scriv
text: The kimtaeyoon87/mcp-server-youtube-transcript tool is unvetted—no proof it handles Alima’s video format or respects YouTube’s TOS. Better: pull transcripts via YouTube’s own API (quota-free for public videos) then parse; that settles the risk with a known, legal pipeline.
